Hi all,

Attaching the authoritative artifacts for Acme. Notes below:

- Attachments (uploaded to customer portal and attached to this thread):
  - SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (final, covers audit period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31)
  - SOC2_bridge_20260630_signed.pdf (bridge letter that extends coverage through 2026-06-30 to account for timing between audits)

Practically, the combination of the 2025 report + the signed bridge is what procurement/security teams should accept for evidence that controls were maintained during the interim period.

- Reissue note: We did reissue an administrative revision to the 2025 PDF in March 2026 which changed the report ID (that likely explains the portal file name confusion). The reissue did not change tested control outcomes, only standardization of the cover page and metadata.

- Actionable text for customer (1-paragraph):

The bridge documents that the policies, procedures, and key controls relevant to data exports and retention were maintained during the interim. Note that an administrative reissue in 03/2026 updated the report cover and ID but did not alter test results. If you require a signed attestation mapping to specific SIG/CAIQ controls, we can provide a short mapping addendum or a signed cover letter."
